scope: Posthoc closure of an already published synthetic IID study; not new blind validation
bootstrap_unit: 48 matched question IDs, carrying both training seeds together
length_analysis: Exploratory descriptive bins of existing cases, not a controlled length sweep
primary_quality_gate: All numerical conditions in owned-lm-v1-design.md must pass at both seeds
closure_gate: A positive joint claim also requires a positive paired quality interval and full-system cost evidence against the parameter-matched control; shorter prompts or state tensor bounds alone are insufficient
new_inference_conditions: None: exactly one regeneration of the frozen primary study
